skill.name: forge-prd-entity

displayName.zh: 需求梳理与 PRD 锻造

skill.usageExample: 帮我梳理内部客户管理系统的需求，明确业务对象、状态和角色权限，再整理成可供开发的 PRD。

description.zh: 围绕 B 端业务对象、字段、状态和角色权限，分阶段完成需求梳理、文字 PRD 和图文 PRD。图文交付需要对应的截图或文档工具。
description.en: Develop B2B requirements, a written PRD, and an illustrated PRD in stages, based on business objects, fields, states, and permissions. Illustrated delivery requires the relevant screenshot or document tools.
